question: Should this change run a full V-process or a bounded delta V-process?
rationale: The change affects existing behavior but does not introduce a new subsystem. Impact analysis and regression selection are mandatory.

options.description: Run the full V-process from requirements through verification.
options.pros: Maximizes review coverage for broad architectural change.
options.cons: Adds unnecessary effort when the change is bounded and traceable.

options.description: Run impact analysis, trace review, regression selection, and approval gate for the affected delta.
options.pros: Focuses review effort on affected requirements, tests, and evidence.
options.cons: Requires disciplined impact analysis to avoid missed affected items.

question: Should trace links be exported to the formal ALM immediately?
rationale: Trace links are candidates until the engineering review confirms affected requirements and test coverage.

options.description: Export candidate trace links before engineering review.
options.pros: Makes candidates visible in the formal tool quickly.
options.cons: Can make unreviewed trace links look authoritative.

options.description: Export only after human review confirms the trace candidates.
options.pros: Preserves the boundary between candidate context and formal ALM state.
options.cons: Adds a review step before formal tool synchronization.
